goal: Reference-set personalization with lower SBP and DBP MAE than personal mean and matched-SE bias correction
working_signal: Worst development MAE ratio against both controls; four existing development participants; seed42 screen
independent_acceptance: Require matched seeds42/43/44 and another prospectively frozen never-used participant cohort. The six historic targets and 16 participants from the 20261012 follow-up are excluded from independent acceptance.
stop_rule: Stop and report if all three development candidates fail. If a candidate passes, replicate seeds before independent verification; never call a development win achieved generalization.
user_notification: Report meaningful progress, verified results, or required action; do not imply guaranteed superiority. Draft email only; no sending.
